                    adjusted_price['low'] = float(adjusted_price['low']) - dividend_amount
                    adjusted_price['close'] = float(adjusted_price['close']) - dividend_amount

# Ensure the weights are within the required format

remaining_weight = 1 - sum(target_weights.values())
if remaining_weight > 0:
    target_weights['cash'] = remaining_weight

print("\nTarget Weights:")
